title: Richards Temporal Runtime Policy and Model-Owned Accuracy Seam

problem_statement.retained_finding: The raw full-versus-two-half Richards endpoint head defect is a useful dimensional diagnostic and fixed-horizon refinement can enter a bounded conservative regime.
problem_statement.rejected_semantics: The existing outer transaction retry topology cannot safely translate that fixed-horizon relation into temporal acceptance. F-VQ28 observed under-conservative retry endpoints and cases that lost a previously conservative relation after retry halving.
problem_statement.consequence: No production temporal tolerance, normalization factor, retry count or retry scale may be fitted onto the rejected topology.

architecture_decision_question: What bounded, model-owned temporal-accuracy semantic should a soil-water solver expose for one requested [t0,t1] advance, and what is the smallest generic transaction/runtime seam needed to consume it without making F-KT depend on Richards internals?

A_MODEL_OWNED_SAME_ENDPOINT_REFINEMENT.description: Richards owns same-endpoint internal substepping/refinement over the requested [t0,t1] and returns a qualified temporal-accuracy certificate with the candidate.
A_MODEL_OWNED_SAME_ENDPOINT_REFINEMENT.potential_strength: Directly aligns the estimator with the endpoint actually returned by the solver and preserves generic external time semantics.
A_MODEL_OWNED_SAME_ENDPOINT_REFINEMENT.known_risk: Naive nested 1+2+4 refinement can be too expensive for MultiSWAP and coupling unless bounded or made incremental.

B_SOLVER_INTEGRATED_EMBEDDED_ESTIMATOR.description: Richards derives a temporal-accuracy estimate from solver-local information such as an embedded discretization pair, residual/history information or reusable factorization data.
B_SOLVER_INTEGRATED_EMBEDDED_ESTIMATOR.potential_strength: Could reduce duplicated full solves and support bounded cost.
B_SOLVER_INTEGRATED_EMBEDDED_ESTIMATOR.known_risk: Scientifically and numerically more invasive; no qualified estimator currently exists.

C_FIXED_BOUNDED_INTERNAL_SUBSTEPS_WITH_D.description: Use a deterministic bounded internal step schedule and keep D_h as diagnostic rather than as an acceptance oracle.
C_FIXED_BOUNDED_INTERNAL_SUBSTEPS_WITH_D.known_risk: Without a separately qualified accuracy envelope it does not provide a temporal-error guarantee and is therefore insufficient as the final reference acceptance policy.

D_KEEP_EXISTING_OUTER_FULL_HALF_AND_ONLY.description: Retain the existing transaction topology and choose another scalar tolerance or normalization.

reason: F-SI owns soil-water solver implementation and its solver-local numerical policy.
F-KT should continue to own checkpoint, rollback, commit and generic admission semantics.
A certificate can keep Richards internals out of F-KT while avoiding misuse of endpoint-state comparison as the only estimator transport.
The existing soil_water_solve_result_t is already the natural F-SI-owned result carrier but does not yet contain such a certificate.

required_gates.gate_A: Resolve whether a model-owned certificate can be represented behind the existing generic soil-water solver API without persistent-state pollution or Richards-specific F-KT coupling.
required_gates.gate_B: Characterize bounded-cost candidate estimators on F-VQ28 hydraulic states without selecting production limits.
required_gates.gate_C: If a transaction/runtime interface change is required, hand it to the owning F-KT/F-CI workstream rather than modifying that owner inside F-SI21.
required_gates.gate_D: Independent F-VQ qualification of the exact candidate estimator, limits, failure semantics and cost envelope before any production admission.
